WITH counts_by_type AS (
  SELECT 
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    SUM(cnt) OVER () as total_count,
    AVG(CAST(cnt AS FLOAT)) OVER () as avg_count
  FROM counts_by_type
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    CAST(cnt AS FLOAT) / total_count as share
  FROM stats
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM shares
  WHERE cnt > avg_count
)
SELECT 
  SUM(cnt) as sum_of_counts,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(cnt - avg_count) as avg_excess
FROM above_avg
